ctx.x: No, he was an actor. I think his name was Wessell -- Henry Wessell; I'm not sure. But anyway, at that time, at the Apollo Theatre, all the shows had like a story behind it, you know? Like 'A Night in Spain,' and all the music was Spanish music, you know? That type thing.
